evidence.claim: The company reports that its platform, operating under the WaveBL brand, has achieved a 65% share of the global electronic bill of lading (eBL) market, processing more than 500,000 eBL issuances in 2025.

The network connects users across more than 100 countries, including 7 of the world's top 12 ocean carriers, 25+ freight forwarders, and banking institutions like Lloyds Bank, Federal Bank, Emirates NBD Bank, U.S. Bank, and Bank Mizrahi.

Market Share & Installed Base.assessed_on: We verified the platform's footprint through documented system integrations and deployments with major ocean liners and international financial institutions. Based on primary research, the company's total live installations market share can be estimated as leading in the digital trade document sector, based on its widespread implementation by major global ocean carriers, freight forwarders, and banking partners globally.
